issues: UI primary flow check failed: after clicking the "Export CSV" and "Export PDF" buttons on the Export screen, the expected text "Export ready to share" never appears, causing the ui_flow test step 51 to time out. The ExportScreen uses a Snackbar to display the success message, but in the web build (used for UI flow testing) the Snackbar does not render the text in a way that the test harness can detect, and generatePdf may throw on web, causing the PDF export to show an error message instead of the expected success message.

Potential cause for PDF export failure: generatePdf relies on expo-print and expo-file-system, which are not available in the web environment used by the UI flow tests, leading to an exception and a "Export failed. Try again." Snackbar instead of the success message.
feedback: Fix the ExportScreen so that the success message is reliably displayed as visible text after both CSV and PDF export actions. Ensure that the PDF export works (or at least resolves without throwing) in the web build used for UI flow testing, possibly by stubbing the native modules or providing a web-friendly implementation. Also consider adding an accessible role or using a simple Text component for the message to make it detectable by the UI flow test.
